req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1, max_length=100). Tests cover: (1) positive — valid title yields 201; (2) negative — missing title yields 422; (3) boundary — empty string title (length=0, one below min_length=1) yields 422; (4) boundary — title of exactly 1 char (min boundary) yields 201; (5) decision-table — null title yields 422. Each test asserts the exact status code to catch comparison-operator mutations (== vs !=, 422 vs 201, etc.).

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201
actions: POST /tasks/ with a valid title and no description
expected: Response body contains id=21, title matches input, completed=false
trace: R-TASK-002: valid title must NOT be rejected; 201 is the success path
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Valid Task Title"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid Task Title"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] == 21

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title_does_not_create_row
actions: GET /tasks/ to verify row count is unchanged
expected: GET /tasks/ returns exactly 20 items (no new row created)
trace: R-TASK-002: a rejected request must not persist any data; row count must remain 20
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_missing_title_does_not_create_row():
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "orphan"})
    assert r_post.status_code == 422
    r_get = client.get("/tasks/?limit=1000")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    tasks = r_get.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 20
